item.spearcore.spear.desc: Charge and stab. Faster movement increases damage.
enchantment.spearcore.lunge.description: Push the attacker forward during a stabbing attack.
tetra.module.spear/head.name: Spearhead
tetra.module.spear/head.description: The spearhead turns the shaft into a spear and provides most of its damage.
tetra.module.spear/handle.name: Long shaft
tetra.module.spear/handle.description: A longer shaft that yields longer reach. Shafts are the primary source of integrity.
tetra.module.spear/binding.name: Binding
tetra.module.spear/binding.description: Tightly bound fibre strengthens the spearhead's attachment to the shaft.
tetra.module.spear/butt.name: Counterweight
tetra.module.spear/butt.description: Weight at the butt end that keeps the spear balanced.
tetra/schematic/spear/head.name: Spearhead
tetra/schematic/spear/head.description: Replace the current spearhead with one made from the given material, or reforge it.
tetra/schematic/spear/handle.name: Shaft
tetra/schematic/spear/handle.description: Replace the current shaft with one made from the given material, or reforge it.
tetra/schematic/spear/binding.name: Binding
tetra/schematic/spear/binding.descriptio: Bind the spearhead to the shaft with fibre or leather.
tetra/schematic/spear/butt.name: Counterweight
tetra/schematic/spear/butt.description: Add or replace the counterweight at the butt end.
tetra.module.spear/socket.name: Socket
tetra.module.spear/socket.description: A gem fitted where the spearhead meets the shaft. The gem's own attributes and effects are carried by the spear.
tetra/schematic/spear/socket.name: Socket
tetra/schematic/spear/socket.description: Socket a gem into the spear, providing different attributes and effects depending on the gem.
tetra.module.spear/shuo_head.name: Shuo head
tetra.module.spear/shuo_head.description: The head of a heavy lance: a long, weighty spike that bites deeper, swings slower and reaches a little further.
tetra.module.spear/composite_shaft.name: Composite shaft
tetra.module.spear/composite_shaft.descr: A wooden core wrapped in split bamboo and lacquered: tough, hard to snap and a little longer than a plain shaft.
tetra.module.spear/three_point_blade.des: A ceremonial three-point, double-edged polearm head. Heavy and wide; only metal and gems can be worked into it.
tetra/schematic/spear/shuo_head.name: Shuo head
tetra/schematic/spear/shuo_head.descript: Replace the spearhead with a heavier, longer shuo head: more damage and reach, less attack speed.
tetra/schematic/spear/composite_shaft.de: Replace the shaft with a laminated bamboo shaft: tougher and longer, but a bit slower to swing.
Forge a three-point, double-edged head: far stronger and longer-reaching than a plain spearhead.
tetra.unlock.tetra.spear/shuo_head.descr: Requires a §lShuo head scroll§r placed nearby
tetra.unlock.tetra.spear/composite_shaft: Requires a §lComposite shaft scroll§r placed nearby
tetra.unlock.tetra.spear/three_point_bla: Requires the §lThree-point blade scroll§r to be placed on the workbench (intricate schematic)
item.tetra.scroll.spear/shuo_head.name: Shuo head
